integrity: The stated all-field result is proved using finite-field orthogonality and exact incidence identities; a standalone finite checker tests, but cannot prove, the unrestricted assertions.
limitations: Exact local second variation at constant extremizers over odd finite fields of order 3 modulo 4; no assertion of uniform-in-field global remainder or unique global optimizer.
title: Two-band Hessian and sharp local gap for anisotropic finite-field paraboloid extension
